producer_report.summary:
I made no changes. The base commit already contains the fix for this cause, so I only ran the two targeted test commands. Root cause: the retire rule, requirement OLY-9-11, read only each job's own invocation list. The steward, audience and auditor runs are kept in separate Records lists, so those roles looked unused. The fix is already in place:
- role_need.rs reads Records::all_invocations and treats the three on-demand roles as 'not measured', never as retire candidates.
- JobRecords::invocations in store.rs has a doc comment pointing to Records::all_invocations.
- docs/system-facts.md has a bullet on where invocations are recorded.
- The role_need unit tests replay the measure over records with those three roles outside any job and check both outcomes.
- The status_role_need test checks the rendered status() output.

The role_need tests (7) and the status_role_need test (1) pass.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/system-facts.md has a section stating that steward, audience and auditor runs are stored outside a job's invocations and that any usage/need/retire measure must read Records::all_invocations and be replayed over real records (Grep for 'all_invocations' in docs/system-facts.md).
criteria_check.evidence: docs/system-facts.md lines 44-48, bullet 'Where invocations are recorded', already present and names all_invocations, the three roles and the replay. It says 'records holding those three roles', not 'real records'.

criteria_check.criterion: JobRecords::invocations in crates/athena-core/src/store.rs carries a doc comment naming the steward, audience and auditor as absent and pointing to Records::all_invocations.
criteria_check.evidence: store.rs ~line 32 doc names and points to Records::all_invocations (Grep hit).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core role_need`: a new test builds Records via from_parts with a standalone steward, audience and auditor run (and none of them in any job's invocations) and asserts none is a retire candidate and each is reported active or not measured; it fails if compute reads job.invocations only, and passes with the change.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: 7 passed. known_active_roles_are_never_retire_candidates_and_an_unused_role_is puts the three runs in steward_runs/audience_runs/auditor_runs, asserts none is flagged and each is in not_measured with a count of 1. The test builds Records with Records::default and field pushes, not from_parts. I did not run it against a job.invocations-only compute to confirm it fails there.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core role_need`: a test over a list of known-active roles asserts the measure yields both outcomes on a mixed record set (some role flagged, some not) and never flags a known-active role.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: the_measure_yields_both_outcomes_on_a_mixed_fixture passes, with an empty candidate list in one fixture and planner and critic flagged in the other. The first test checks the known-active roles are never flagged.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a test shows dropped, stale and abandoned jobs do not enter the closed-job window or the class totals; the existing all_invocations_covers_every_loaded_invocation test still passes.
criteria_check.evidence: I ran only the role_need filter, which passes. jobs_that_never_ran_a_model_are_left_out_of_the_window covers dropped, stale, abandoned, declined and closed jobs. I did not run the full athena-core suite, so all_invocations_covers_every_loaded_invocation was not re-run. The test only checks the closed-job window, not 'class totals'.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli status_role_need`: rendering through status() prints the role need line only when a candidate exists and never names the auditor, steward or audience as a candidate.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: 1 passed. The test renders through athena_cli::display::status and asserts the steward, audience and auditor are not named in the candidate part of the line.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the root cause (usage measure read a partial run source) and the fix; docs/spec.toml OLY-9-11 mechanism and measure still end with `status: role need`.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md lines ~18-20 name all_invocations and the fix. I did not read the full entry. I saw only the OLY-9-11 mechanism line in docs/spec.toml (line 1497), not the measure field or either ending.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`; all pass.

open_issues: I changed no files, so I added no new test for the 'class totals' part of criterion 5.
I did not run cargo test -p xtask --test policy or cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors, and I did not run the full cargo test.
learnings: The base commit already holds the full fix: field docs, system-facts bullet, windowed role_need with replay tests, the status_role_need test, the spec entry and the changelog entry.
